# Turingo — full description

Turingo is a macOS app that coordinates work in Claude Code and Codex. The user talks to Turingo (voice or chat); Turingo runs the user's projects according to what they agreed.

## How it works

1. You say or type what should be built and agree the scope with Turingo.
2. Turingo hands tasks to the right Claude Code and Codex sessions in your projects.
3. You get a verified result: a report with evidence, by voice or in chat. When your decision is needed, Turingo asks and waits.

## Coordinator capabilities

- Two agents, one point of contact: Claude Code and Codex; the agent is picked separately for the coordinator and for every project session.
- Many projects at once: a registry of projects and sessions; Turingo knows what runs where, what waits for you and what is blocked.
- Done means verified: task states and evidence of completion.
- No collisions: a session open in Terminal has priority; tasks wait until it is closed.
- Approvals and questions by voice, with announcement modes (voice, silent, do not disturb); urgent items always get through.
- Per-role model and effort settings; session monitoring does not burn tokens.

## Voice

Input: push-to-talk or voice activity detection; recognition on-device or via the user's own Groq key; chat window as an alternative.
Output: ElevenLabs (user's key), macOS system voice or a local model.

## Privacy

No Turingo server. Conversation history and memory are stored locally per account. Users bring their own subscriptions and keys.

## Personality

An animated face widget shows state (listening, thinking, speaking, waiting, done). Character and humor are secondary to the coordination features.

## Status and requirements

Under construction and in testing. No release date. macOS 14+. Waitlist: https://turingo.app/

## Maker

AI Fresh, Wrocław, Poland — https://aifresh.pl/ — method: https://aifresh.pl/jak-pracujemy/
